class Hund:
    art = "Säugetier"
    def __init__(self, name, alter):
        self.name = name
        self.alter = alter

name: match_case
code:
def tag(n):
    match n:
        case 1:
            return "Montag"
        case 2 | 3:
            return "Di/Mi"
        case 6 | 7:
            return "Wochenende"
        case x if x > 7:
            return "zu groß"
        case _:
            return "anderer Tag"
for n in [1, 3, 7, 9, 5]:
    print(tag(n))
befehl = "start"
match befehl:
    case "start":
        print("Los!")
    case "stop":
        print("Halt!")
output:
Montag
Di/Mi
Wochenende
zu groß
anderer Tag

name: decorators
generators
code:
def zaehle(n):
    i = 1
    while i <= n:
        yield i
        i += 1
for x in zaehle(3):
    print(x)
g = zaehle(2)
print(next(g), next(g))
print(list(zaehle(4)), sum(zaehle(4)))
q = (x * x for x in range(4))
print(list(q))
print(sum(x for x in range(5)), max(len(w) for w in ["a", "abc"]))
def fib():
    a, b = 0, 1
    for _ in range(7):
        yield a
        a, b = b, a + b
print(list(fib()))
